lines: Características: acolhe sem pressionar ("Apenas relaxe..."); curiosa mas paciente; calor humano.
Red flags: soar fria, clínica ou impaciente; formalidade excessiva.
Haku (protagonista, narração 1ª pessoa) — `voice_criticality: high`. Predomina nas 2 cenas:
Características: sentenças curtas e definitivas; duplo sentido ("um mundo totalmente novo te espera"); ambiguidade ameaçadora.
Red flags: soar caloroso/paternal; resolver a ambiguidade (a fala deve permanecer dúbia).
Registro: erudito cômico, pomposo e arcaico; bajulador do Ukon; alívio cômico.
Características: fala arcaica/empolada (equivalente a "vós/peço-vos/meus olhos não me enganam") + gag de cicio (s→sh, ex.: "SHEEKETH"/"shir"); melodramático; gruda no Haku como "benfeitor".
Red flags: perder o arcaísmo ou o cicio (são a piada); soar moderno/neutro; explicar a comédia. Manter o contraste entre a pompa do vocabulário e a fragilidade do personagem.

Oshtor — `voice_criticality: high`. = Ukon até 13_08 (ver spoiler_ledger). Registro formal, nobre, comedido; General da Direita. Antes do reveal, traduzir como o mercenário "Ukon" (espirituoso, informal) — NÃO antecipar a pompa de general
Características: frases quebradas por reticências; perguntas curtas ("Quem... é você...?"); pouca pontuação forte.
Red flags: falas fluentes/articuladas demais; perder o tom de torpor; pontuação "limpa" que apaga a fragmentação.
Registro: guerreiro carismático, espirituoso, caloroso e informal; líder nato que trata Haku como um irmão mais novo.
Características: desembaraçado, brincalhão, generoso; fala direta e cativante; autoridade leve (lidera a Coorte) sem arrogância.
Red flags: soar rígido/formal/militar demais (a graça é justamente o contraste com a patente); frieza. SPOILER: não deixar a tradução insinuar a identidade verdadeira — no cap.12 ele é só "Ukon".

decisions.title: Opcode de RÓTULO DE FALANTE `53 00` + reconcile de speaker (data-driven)
decisions.summary: **Problema:** in-game, o rótulo de falante aparecia em **inglês** ("Girl") mesmo com a tradução ("Garota") aprovada e gravada. RE: o nome do falante usa um **2º opcode de ponteiro, `53 00`** (mesmo formato file-relativo do `50 00` de diálogo), que o conector ignorava. Resultado: "Girl"→"Garota"

decisions.title: Gate de charset pt-BR — método e veredito
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar `target_charset_supported: likely` e exigir confirmação in-game antes de produção. **Alternativas consideradas:** - Confirmar por presença no texto-fonte — **insuficiente**: o fonte é inglês e quase não usa acentos (só `õ` e `À` aparecem em texto real).

decisions.title: Anomalia 0x33f9 — texto PT/EN corrompido na fonte
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar a linha `0x33f9` como anomalia de fonte (não traduzir em cima do lixo; tratar como linha de sistema reescrita). **Razão:** A string original já vem misturada PT/EN e truncada ("...SISTEMAS AM . RESTARTING...") no próprio jogo. Não é erro de extração. O conector deve sinali

decisions.title: Charset — transliteração na gravação (gate FALHOU)
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar `target_charset_supported: false` e **transliterar** (acento → ASCII) na gravação do binário. A tradução canônica (`approved_translations.csv`, `translation_plan.json`) **mantém os acentos** (correta para QA/revisão); apenas os bytes escritos no jogo são dobrados para ASCI

lines.source: From far off, the cries of the Yamatan army\n
can be heard.
Adviser
My owlo, the Yamatan army is swiftly closing\n
in on our position.
Although we may stall them for now, it is only\n
a matter of time before they break through...
We need a decision.
Very well... What will be my options?
For now, we can flee to the west... Uzurusha\n
is wide and vast. Even the Yamatans could not\n
maintain pursuit.
As long as you live, my owlo, we may regroup.\n
You can reclaim the separated units on our\n
return.
Now is the time to persevere...
Ghhhh...!!
The room falls silent, apart from the sounds of\n
battle outside. All freeze as the man's head\n
rolls.
Soldier
Ah... Ahhh!
The owlo brandishes his bloodstained blade.
...You dare tell me to turn tail?\n
You dare tell me to abandon my homeland!?
My owlo, please! You must understand!
You DARE!!
My owlo!!
Hmh...
Commander Zeguni stares into Gundhurua's eyes\n
unflinchingly.
Gundhurua finally relents at his determined\n
gaze, and sheathes his sword as he turns his\n
back.
We shall go, then... Zeguni.
My owlo...
This is not a retreat...
We are merely shifting course!
Y-Yes, milord...!
We shall return here one day!
Those who yet live, rise and escort our owlo!
Sir!
Zeguni follows the retreating soldiers, but\n
pauses a moment to look up at the sky.
...Entua.
Zeguni speaks the name of his absent daughter.
Are you still alive...? Then please, do not\n
throw your life away in vain. You must live.\n
Grovel, bow, and scrape, but live...
There are no signs of pursuit. It may be too\n
difficult to follow us over such treacherous\n
terrain.
And with their numbers, it would surely take\n
time to get through here.
If we are able to regroup in that time--
Gundhurua, who had been showing no sign of\n
attention to Zeguni's words, suddenly halts.
Owlo?
Th-That is...
A single man stands before the remnants of the\n
Uzurushan army, blocking their way.
Khuhahaha... So that is it...\n
I understand now why there was no pursuit.
The old man's favorite lapdog has come for me.
The Imperial Guard of the Right, Oshtor!
When I did not see your face on the field,\n
I thought you cowering behind your capital's\n
walls...
You gnat! You make me laugh.\n
Was this supposed to be an ambush?
You dare think you can stand in my way!?
No.
What...?
The orders given to me by the Mikado were to\n
exterminate.
Hmph. So that old relic thinks me little more\n
than a pest, eh?
Very well, Oshtor. But I warn you now;\n
my head will not be so easily taken.
As Gundhurua draws his blade and begins\n
advancing, Zeguni kneels before him to block\n
his way.
My owlo.
Oh? So you would obstruct my path as well?
No, my owlo. I would ask your permission.
Then speak.
I ask that you allow me to handle this.
I wish to slay this bearer of the mask to\n
attain glory.
Gundhurua stares at the commander's face for a\n
moment, then mutters.
I see... Martyrdom, is it?
Old fool... You may do as you please.
I thank you for this honor.\n
I promise to kill him without fail!
Gundhurua does not reply as he turns his back\n
on Zeguni.
Zeguni stands and draws his blade.
Those of you who seek glory, follow me!\n
Oshtor's head will be worth one thousand\n
gold!
Raaaaaaaaah!!
Zeguni charges Oshtor together with his soldiers.
You would sacrifice your own life to allow\n
Gundhurua to escape... I commend your valor.
Haaaaaaaaaah!!
Then I shall honor your resolve...
Gaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
With one swing of Oshtor's massive arm, the\n
closest Uzurushan soldiers are flung aside.
These masked generals are nothing short of\n
monsters... Numbers mean nothing against them.\n
So, then--
Oshtor!!
I am Commander Zeguni of Uzurusha!\n
I challenge you to a duel!
It would be shameful of me to deny such a brave\n
warrior as yourself.
I accept.
Hm... So you will not use that accursed mask\n
against me. That's quite arrogant of you...
I would claim victory against a true warrior\n
with my own hands!
Then let your arrogance be your downfall!
Haaaaaaaaaah!
Entua, following the remaining Uzurusha forces\n
to the west, tracks their escape to a raging\n
battle.
...That... crest on the flag...
Father!!
Hrraaaaaah!!
Ggh!!
Oshtor's powerful strikes knock Zeguni back\n
across the ground, even as he blocks with his\n
blade.
The difference in power is too great...\n
Zeguni cannot land a single blow, and he is\n
soon knocked down.
S-Such power... It seems I am no match for you...\n
However--
Hm...
Zeguni's body is covered in wounds, but he still\n
stands, defying the pain coursing through him.
You shall not pass... Even if my body is\n
destroyed... I shall not let you pass!!
So you still stand... I did not expect to\n
encounter such a warrior as yourself among\n
the Uzurushans.
However, I am a warrior of Yamato in service\n
of the Mikado!
I shall show no forgiveness to those that bring\n
despair to my liege, and suffering to my people.
Lord Zeguni, come at me with all your might!
This will be our final strike!\n
Let this end our duel!
Very well. Then taste the might of my final\n
strike... for I shall put my very life behind\n
it!
HAAAAAAAAAAH!!
It ends in a flash. Each sword strikes with\n
speed beyond the eye's perception...\n
and silence falls.
And then...
Blood spurts in a line across Zeguni's chest\n
to his shoulder.
Oshtor's strike has left a fatal cut diagonally\n
across Zeguni's body.
Ghaaah...!!
The scent of blood fills the air as Zeguni\n
staggers, his sword clattering to the ground.
However... as Zeguni looks toward Oshtor, his\n
face shows only a gentle serenity.
...Impressive... I would expect no less from\n
the Imperial Guard of the Right...
Your skills are remarkable, as well...
Hah... So I have succeeded... in landing one\n
strike.
A small trickle of blood trails down Oshtor's\n
body. A small cut, but Zeguni's blade had\n
indeed reached him.
Then I have no regrets...\n
I thank you for this battle...
A satisfied smile crosses Zeguni's face...\n
and he crumples to the ground.
What an extraordinary man you were.\n
You protected your lord, and died with honor\n
as a brave samurai.
You truly embody the spirit of a mononofu...
Lord Zeguni... I can only hope that I one day\n
meet my end as you did yours...\n
With honor.
NOOOOOOOO!!
Father! FATHER!
A girl jumps from the brush and runs to the man\n
on the ground, tears streaming down her face.
Entua glares up at Oshtor.
You... You did this to him...
Entua swiftly draws a shortsword from her side.
You will PAY for what you've done!
Nh, nnngh...
Entua's sword strikes Oshtor directly in the\n
stomach.
However, the blade does not pierce him.\n
It is stopped at the surface, as Entua's hand\n
begins to shake.
...I am afraid your skill with a sword will not\n
be enough to make a scratch on me.
Aah!!
Oshtor grabs the blade of Entua's sword and\n
rips it from her hand. The force casts her to\n
the ground.
You... You killed my father!
...I cannot excuse what I have done. Nor will I\n
run from it. I have chosen a path of carnage.
But... I would not have you share your father's\n
fate.
Oshtor turns his back on Entua as if she doesn't\n
even exist, intent on pursuing Gundhurua.
Entua can do nothing but watch as he departs.
Oshtor quickly begins pursuing Gundhurua as he\n
leaves the site of his duel.
Yet the remaining Uzurushans continue to resist,\n
and sacrifice themselves to let Gundhurua\n
escape.
Many Uzurushans fall to Oshtor's blade, but in\n
the end, Gundhurua is never found among the\n
dead.
Meanwhile, the other generals begin subjugating\n
the rest of Uzurusha, mountains of corpses in\n
their wake.
With their leader on the run, the Uzurushan\n
people soon give in, and Yamato assumes\n
political control.
Thus ends the great war between Yamato and\n
Uzurusha...
